Version: 0.3 synthetic example
System Owner: Jane Example, Director of Platform Security
Information System Security Officer: Pat Example

sections.heading: System Description
sections.excerpt: Acme Analytics Platform is a synthetic multi-tenant analytics service used for demonstration. The system processes test telemetry, generated customer-like records, and operational logs. No real customer data is included in this example.

sections.heading: Boundary

sections.heading: Users
sections.excerpt: The system has three user groups: platform administrators, tenant administrators, and read-only analysts.

sections.heading: AC-2 Account Management
sections.excerpt: User accounts are provisioned through the corporate identity provider. Administrative access requires approval in the ticketing system. Accounts are reviewed quarterly by the system owner and disabled after termination notifications.

sections.heading: IA-2 Identification and Authentication
sections.excerpt: All interactive users authenticate with SSO and phishing-resistant MFA where available. Service accounts use short-lived workload identity tokens.

sections.heading: SC-13 Cryptographic Protection
sections.excerpt: Data in transit uses TLS 1.2 or higher. Data at rest is encrypted with cloud-managed keys. The team plans to evaluate customer-managed keys in the next release.

sections.heading: AU-2 Event Logging
sections.excerpt: The application logs authentication events, administrative actions, configuration changes, and data export requests. Logs are forwarded to the central security logging project.
